# Pull request / 拉取请求

## Purpose / 目的

<!-- What problem does this change solve? / 这个变更解决什么问题？ -->

## Changes / 变更

<!-- Describe the smallest coherent set of changes. / 描述本次最小且完整的变更集。 -->

## Evidence and provenance / 证据与来源

<!-- For data changes, link inspectable sources and record observation time. / 数据变更请提供可检查的来源并记录观察时间。 -->

## Compatibility and risk / 兼容性与风险

<!-- Note schema, migration, privacy, security, or operational impact. / 说明 Schema、迁移、隐私、安全或运行影响。 -->

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] I ran `npm run check`. / 我已执行 `npm run check`。
- [ ] I updated generated artifacts with `npm run build` when source data changed. / 源数据变化时，我已通过 `npm run build` 更新生成物。
- [ ] I updated both English and Simplified Chinese normative documents when meaning changed. / 语义变化时，我已同步更新英文和简体中文规范文档。
- [ ] I have the right to contribute all submitted code, documentation, and data. / 我有权贡献所提交的代码、文档和数据。
- [ ] This change contains no secrets or private personal data. / 本次变更不包含密钥或私人个人数据。

## Related work / 关联事项

<!-- Link issues, ADRs, or specifications. Use "Closes #123" when appropriate. / 关联 Issue、ADR 或规格；适用时使用 "Closes #123"。 -->
